en: Vintage sepia-toned street view showing a cobblestone street lined with 2–3 story buildings. Signs on the buildings advertise restaurants, including one labeled "Stadt Leipzig" and another "Restauration von Eduard Berge". People are standing and walking along the street. In the distance are larger civic-looking buildings and trees. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as Radeburg, Albertstrasse, with the town hall and district court (Stadthaus und Amtsgericht).
